evals.name: TC1-full-scan
evals.prompt: /audit-devkit-scan — scan tất cả agents, skills, templates, rules. Output structured JSON
evals.expected_output: Creates .mc-data/work/audit-devkit-scan/[session]/audit-index.json (schema audit-index-v1), multiple findings-*.json files (schema audit-findings-v1), and audit-scan-result.json (schema audit-scan-result-v1). Business agents split into 2 sub-batches (1.1a + 1.1b). Batches ≤20 files each. Scripts scan (Wave 3.5) produces findings-scripts.json. Summary table displayed to user.

assertions.text: .mc-data/work/audit-devkit-scan/[session]/audit-index.json is created with $schema: 'audit-index-v1'
audit-index.json has counts.agents > 0 AND counts.skills > 0
audit-index.json has counts.total equal to sum of all component counts
findings-agents-business-a.json AND findings-agents-business-b.json both created (business team split into 2 batches)
At least one findings-*.json file created in .mc-data/work/audit-devkit-scan/[session]/ with $schema: 'audit-findings-v1'
.mc-data/work/audit-devkit-scan/[session]/audit-scan-result.json created with $schema: 'audit-scan-result-v1'
audit-scan-result.json has summary.total = length of findings array
Output report displayed to user with breakdown by component and output file paths

evals.name: TC2-agents-only
evals.expected_output: Scans only agent files (.claude/agents/**/*.md). Business agents split into 2 sub-batches. Creates audit-index.json showing only agents scanned, findings-agents-*.json files. Does NOT scan skills/templates/rules/hooks/scripts.

assertions.text: .mc-data/work/audit-devkit-scan/[session]/audit-index.json is created
Only agent-related findings files are created (findings-agents-*.json)
No findings-skills-*.json or findings-templates.json or findings-scripts.json created
scan-status.json scope is set to 'agents' (not 'all')

evals.name: TC3-skills-only
evals.expected_output: Scans only skill files (.claude/skills/**/SKILL.md). Creates audit-index.json with skills metadata, findings-skills-*.json files. Does NOT scan agents/templates/rules/hooks/scripts.

assertions.text: .mc-data/work/audit-devkit-scan/[session]/audit-index.json is created with counts.skills > 0
findings-skills-workflow.json and/or findings-skills-other.json are created
No findings-agents-*.json files created
scan-status.json scope is set to 'skills' (not 'all')

evals.name: TC4-resume
evals.prompt: /audit-devkit-scan --resume — tiếp tục từ checkpoint khi session trước bị gián đoạn giữa Phase 1
evals.expected_output: Reads existing scan-status.json từ .mc-data/work/audit-devkit-scan/[session]/, identifies completed batches, continues từ pending batches. Không re-scan completed batches. Loads existing audit-index.json thay vì rebuild.

assertions.text: Skill reads .mc-data/work/audit-devkit-scan/[session]/scan-status.json to determine progress
Completed batches are NOT re-run (no duplicate findings files)
Pending batches are executed and new findings-*.json files created
Final audit-scan-result.json includes findings from both old and new batches

evals.name: TC5-master-plan-scan
evals.prompt: /audit-devkit-scan --all — scan toàn bộ bao gồm Wave 4 Master Plan components
evals.expected_output: Runs full scan including Wave 4 (MP-1 to MP-7). Populates master_plan_components in audit-index.json. Creates findings-masterplan-*.json files for deployed components. NOT_FOUND components do not create findings files.

assertions.text: audit-index.json contains master_plan_components section with 7 groups (hook_2tier, baseline_metrics, checkpoint_digest, digest_pipeline, executable_spec_a6ext, micro_task_a7ext, parallel_execution)
Each master_plan_components field is populated: true, false, or 'NOT_FOUND'
Components with NOT_FOUND status do NOT generate findings files
audit-scan-result.json source_files[] includes any findings-masterplan-*.json files created

evals.name: TC6-templates-only
evals.expected_output: Scans only template files (.claude/doc-framework/**/*.md). Creates audit-index.json with templates metadata, findings-templates-*.json files. Does NOT scan agents/skills/rules/hooks/scripts.

assertions.text: .mc-data/work/audit-devkit-scan/[session]/audit-index.json is created with counts.templates > 0
findings-templates-a.json and/or findings-templates-b.json are created
No findings-agents-*.json or findings-skills-*.json files created
scan-status.json scope is set to 'templates' (not 'all')

evals.name: TC7-rules-only
evals.expected_output: Scans only rule files (.claude/rules/*.md). Creates audit-index.json with rules metadata, findings-rules.json. Does NOT scan agents/skills/templates/hooks/scripts.

assertions.text: .mc-data/work/audit-devkit-scan/[session]/audit-index.json is created with counts.rules > 0
findings-rules.json is created
No findings-agents-*.json or findings-skills-*.json or findings-templates-*.json files created
scan-status.json scope is set to 'rules' (not 'all')

evals.name: TC8-hooks-only
evals.expected_output: Scans hook scripts (.claude/hooks/*.sh) excluding _hook-utils.sh. Bash verify: syntax check, path refs, executable permissions. Creates findings-hooks.json. Does NOT scan agents/skills/templates/rules/scripts.

assertions.text: .mc-data/work/audit-devkit-scan/[session]/audit-index.json is created with counts.hooks > 0
findings-hooks.json is created
_hook-utils.sh is NOT scanned as a regular hook (excluded per v1.2)
No findings-agents-*.json or findings-skills-*.json files created
scan-status.json scope is set to 'hooks' (not 'all')

evals.name: TC9-focused-skill-scan
evals.prompt: /audit-devkit-scan --skill=wf-design — chỉ scan skill wf-design cụ thể
evals.expected_output: Skip Wave 1 (agents), Wave 3 (templates/rules/hooks), Wave 3.5 (scripts), Wave 4 (master plan). Chỉ chạy Wave 2 focused: 1 skill-auditor agent cho wf-design/SKILL.md + _contract.json. Lightweight cross-ref: đọc cross_skill_contracts → verify downstream/upstream paths. Output: findings-skills-focused.json.

assertions.text: .mc-data/work/audit-devkit-scan/[session]/findings-skills-focused.json is created with $schema: 'audit-findings-v1'
No findings-agents-*.json files created (Wave 1 skipped)
No findings-templates-*.json or findings-rules.json or findings-hooks.json created (Wave 3 skipped)
No findings-masterplan-*.json files created (Wave 4 skipped)
scan-status.json scope is set to 'skill:wf-design'

evals.name: TC10-delta-scan
evals.prompt: /audit-devkit-scan --since=abc1234 — delta scan chỉ files thay đổi từ commit abc1234
evals.expected_output: Run git diff --name-only abc1234..HEAD -- .claude/ to get changed files. Phân loại changed files vào batches. Chỉ scan batches chứa changed files. Unchanged batches skip (giữ findings cũ nếu có). Output chỉ chứa findings cho changed components.

assertions.text: git diff --name-only abc1234..HEAD -- .claude/ is executed to get changed file list
scan-status.json has delta_scan field with source commit 'abc1234'
Batches with no changed files are NOT scanned (skipped)
audit-scan-result.json includes only findings from changed file batches

evals.name: TC11-component-alias-and-conflict
evals.prompt: /audit-devkit-scan --component=skills --agents — cả 2 formats, --component có priority cao hơn
evals.expected_output: Parse arguments: detect both --component=skills and --agents. --component=X has higher priority → scope set to 'skills'. Log WARNING ARGUMENT_CONFLICT. Behaves identically to --skills only: scans only skill files.

assertions.text: WARNING log with error_code ARGUMENT_CONFLICT is displayed
Scope resolves to 'skills' (--component=skills takes precedence over --agents)
scan-status.json scope is set to 'skills' and invoked_as includes both arguments
No findings-agents-*.json files created (agents scope overridden)
